text:
mira: Quick note: ran a short canary for nova-v2 q4f (int8). Seeing small but consistent errors when zero-width/hair-space chars appear next to punctuation.

mira: Example failure: input contains U+200D between word+punct -> output loses joiner and inserts space. Small sample BLEU drops: ja -2.8, ar -3.9.

devon: Did we fold hair-space in remap for q4f? We packed whitespace variants last sprint.

mira: I think so. Bisect suggests fp32 + tok v3 = baseline, q4f + tok v3 = worst, q4f + tok v2 = smaller delta.

eva: Can you upload 6 repros (input, token ids, outputs)? Ill add to harness and run token-diff matrices.

kai: @eval-bot please queue compare: nova-v2 fp32 vs q4f on hair/zwj subset and return token-level diffs.

eval-bot: Compare queued: compare-1771000001. Link: https://ci.redwood/nova/compare/1771000001

devon: Quick triage: try remap_passthrough=true and kernel=fp32-emulate on q4f to separate remap vs numeric packing.

mira: Running remap_passthrough now, will post traces in ~30m.

eval-bot: Compare finished: short summary: JA -2.6, AR -3.8; token diffs show hair-space/ZWJ substitutions cluster near punctuation. Results: https://ci.redwood/nova/compare/1771000001/results

eva: If remap_passthrough fixes >90% of cases we should disable folding for q4f canary and add synthetic hair/ZWJ test to gate.

devon: Agreed. I'll audit remap folding and KVC packing.

mira: Thanks all  will follow up with S3 repro link and a short staging note if we flip remap_passthrough.
